flightControl.armNotConfigured: ARM mode not configured. Click below to auto-configure for SITL testing.
flightControl.dismissPrearmTitle: Dismiss these. A check that's still failing reappears when the flight controller re-reports it.
flightControl.forceArmTitle: Bypass pre-arm checks. Use only when the failing check is known-safe.
flightControl.forceTitle: Force ARM bypasses pre-arm safety checks
flightControl.missionNotOnVehicleBody: The planned mission ({{count}} waypoints) has not been uploaded to the flight controller, so starting AUTO now would not fly it.
flightControl.missionNotUploaded: Mission not uploaded to the vehicle yet
flightControl.restartTitle: Restart mission from the first waypoint

inFlightAdjust.altTip: New target altitude above home for the current target (DO_CHANGE_ALTITUDE). In AUTO the next waypoint sets its own altitude again.
inFlightAdjust.radiusTip: Writes WP_LOITER_RAD after you review it. Used by LOITER and loiter waypoints; the sign (direction) is kept.
inFlightAdjust.speedTip: New target airspeed (DO_CHANGE_SPEED). Holds until the mission or another command changes it.
inFlightAdjust.title: In-flight adjust

joystickPanel.armedWarning: Armed. The sticks are live: this window must keep focus, because a browser stops reporting the controller when it does not have it.
joystickPanel.fpsHint: {{fps}} frames/s · stop sending and the vehicle returns to its receiver within a second
joystickPanel.offHint: Everything below is switched off until this is on
joystickPanel.ownReceiver: Vehicle flies on its own receiver
joystickPanel.pickInput: Pick an input first: connect a gamepad or switch on the on-screen sticks.
joystickPanel.plugInHint: Plug in a gamepad and press a button so the browser sees it, or a handset in USB Joystick mode, or use the on-screen sticks below
joystickPanel.sendsHint: Sends your sticks to the vehicle. Only the channels you assigned are sent; everything else stays with the receiver.
joystickPanel.standardLayoutWarning: The browser forced this device into the console-pad layout, which hides every axis past the first four. Switches will not be assignable.
joystickPanel.turnOnFirst: Turn joystick input on above first.
joystickPanel.virtualHint: Where the stick positions come from, instead of a physical gamepad. Throttle holds where you leave it; the right stick springs back. Both centre if the window loses focus.
joystickPanel.virtualMappingNote: The on-screen sticks do not use this mapping: they go to the channels the vehicle names in RCMAP_ROLL / PITCH / THROTTLE / YAW. The bars below still show what is being sent.
joystickPanel.virtualOffHint: Turn joystick input on above to use these.

mapPanel.dividerTip: Drag to resize, or use the X to close the split
mapPanel.largeMission: Large mission: showing key waypoints (launch, turns, landing) and the live target. The full flight path is still drawn.
mapPanel.needsArmed: Map commands need an armed vehicle.
mapPanel.noVehicleSelected: No vehicle selected: click a vehicle marker before commanding.
mapPanel.splitCurrentSub: Keep what is on screen as the split layout
mapPanel.splitKeepSub: Leave the layout as it is
mapPanel.splitLayoutQuestion: Switch the instruments to a layout sized for the half-width map?
mapPanel.splitPresetSub: The split cockpit layout (a saved layout named "split" wins)
mapPanel.splitTip: Split the map with another panel

modulePolygonPick.doneTip: Double click the map, or Enter

ntripPanel.baseHint: The receiver must be configured as a base (surveyed-in or fixed position) and output RTCM3 on this port.
ntripPanel.mountpointInHost: "{{host}}" is a mountpoint, not a caster host. Put the caster server name in Host and "{{host}}" in Mountpoint.
ntripPanel.ownerDirectTip: This desktop runs the NTRIP client and injects into the connected vehicle
ntripPanel.ownerOrchestratorTip: The multi-vehicle engine runs the NTRIP client and injects corrections into every vehicle
ntripPanel.protocolTip: NTRIP revision. Auto tries v2 and falls back to v1
ntripPanel.rescanTip: Rescan serial ports. Ports used by an active vehicle connection are not listed.
ntripPanel.sendPositionTip: Uploads the vehicle's GPS position as NMEA GGA. Required by VRS / network mountpoints.
ntripPanel.sourceSerialTip: Corrections from a base receiver plugged into this computer. Works fully offline.

safetyMonitorPanel.enablePidTip: Set the roll+pitch bits of GCS_PID_MASK so the FC streams PID_TUNING
safetyMonitorPanel.groundInferred: Ground state inferred (no EXTENDED_SYS_STATE on this link).
safetyMonitorPanel.replayTip: Replay a recorded .tlog through the monitor
safetyMonitorPanel.tipoverActive: Armed & on the ground - tip-over watch active

sitlStatusPanel.mismatch: FC not receiving GCS values. Check: <c>set receiver_type = MSP</c>
sitlStatusPanel.title: SITL Status

takeoff.copterButtonHint: Arm, switch to GUIDED, climb vertically (NAV_TAKEOFF)
takeoff.notReached: Did not reach {{alt}}: vehicle still armed in QHover, take RC control
takeoff.planeButtonHint: Set TKOFF_ALT, switch to TAKEOFF mode, hand-launch / runway
takeoff.planeDialogNote: Plane goes into TAKEOFF mode. Needs hand-launch, runway, or catapult to start the roll.
takeoff.planeMisconfigured: Plane takeoff misconfigured: no TAKEOFF mode set
takeoff.px4ButtonHint: Arm, switch to AUTO_TAKEOFF, climb to MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT
takeoff.px4DialogNote: PX4 auto-takeoff: sets MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT and switches to AUTO_TAKEOFF at the current position.
takeoff.subHint: Sub does not use a takeoff command
takeoff.vtolButtonHint: Arm in QSTABILIZE, switch to GUIDED with Q_GUIDED_MODE, hover up (NAV_VTOL_TAKEOFF)
takeoff.vtolDialogNote: Hovers up using Q-modes (NAV_VTOL_TAKEOFF). Forward-flight transition is manual after.
takeoff.waitingGps: Waiting for GPS/EKF ({{waited}}s): fix={{fix}} sats={{sats}} hdop={{hdop}}
